high: Vision QA can reuse stale results and falsely pass: every invocation reads the shared /tmp/jc-artqa-reply.txt without deleting it first or requiring the current Codex process to succeed. A failed or concurrent invocation can therefore consume an earlier valid PASS, violating fail-closed QA.
medium: The provider abstraction is incomplete: reuse, CSS, and SVG bypass art-provider.mjs; CSS/SVG merely create manifest entries marked in_session_task without producing or verifying an artifact. The adapter itself exposes only generate, compose, and human-boundary.

Asset link QA recognizes only a narrow helper definition and double-quoted literal calls. Single-quoted calls, template literals, imported helpers, and computed arguments evade validation, so its general fail-closed claim is too broad.

art-needs.json retains an ESSENTIAL classification while resolving it through an override whose cited design decision calls it optional. This leaves classification and resolution semantics inconsistent and permits ESSENTIAL needs to be suppressed without reclassification.
low: The art-loop lock has no PID-liveness or stale-lock recovery check; an abnormal termination can permanently block later runs until manual deletion.

The recorded provider probe result asserts that probe.png was generated and visually checked, but probe-codex-gen.json records only tool availability and the probe image itself is absent. The three generated production assets nevertheless provide stronger practical evidence that the provider could generate and save files.

recommended_actions: Use a unique mkdtemp-created QA reply path per invocation, remove it before execution, require r.status === 0, and parse only a newly created file.
Route reuse/CSS/SVG through explicit provider-adapter operations that actually validate or produce their outputs; do not mark placeholder manifest records as completed work.
Replace regex-only link checking with AST-based extraction or broaden it to all literal quote styles, template literals, imported helpers, and resolvable computed calls.
Require overrides to explicitly reclassify a need with an auditable reason, or prohibit resolved_by_design from suppressing an item that remains classified ESSENTIAL.
Add stale-lock recovery using PID/liveness metadata and atomic ownership checks.
Persist the probe image plus dimensions/hash/verification result, or make provider-status reference the generated production evidence used to establish the probe.
